map.输入功率值与参考功率，按 10·log₁₀(P/P₀) 换算为分贝（dB），将宽: Enter a power and a reference power and convert to decibels (dB) with 10·log₁₀(P/P₀), compressing a wide dynamic range into a comparable quantity — for acoustics, electroacoustics and communication power levels.
map.功率比用 10 倍对数表达为分贝。: A power ratio expressed in decibels uses 10 times the logarithm.
map.声功率级 Lw=10·log10(W/W0)，W0=10⁻¹² W，用于设备声功: Sound power level Lw=10·log10(W/W0), with W0=10⁻¹² W, used for rating equipment sound power.
map.电功率用 dBW（基准 1 W）或 dBm（基准 1 mW）表示。: Electrical power is expressed in dBW (1 W reference) or dBm (1 mW reference).
map.把实测功率换算成统一的 dB 刻度做比对。: Convert measured power to a unified dB scale for comparison.
map.：设备辐射声功率 W=0.01 W，W0=10⁻¹² W，Lw=10·log10: : equipment sound power W=0.01 W with W0=10⁻¹² W gives Lw=10·log10(0.01/1e-12)=10·log10(1e10)=100 dB.
map.场量（电压/声压）之比转分贝: Field quantity (voltage / sound pressure) ratio to decibel
map.dBW 与 dBm 怎么换算？: How do dBW and dBm convert?
map.dBm 以 1 mW 为基准、dBW 以 1 W 为基准，相差 30 dB：X: dBm is referenced to 1 mW and dBW to 1 W, 30 dB apart: X dBW = (X+30) dBm.
map.声功率级和声压级一样吗？: Is sound power level the same as sound pressure level?
map.不一样：声功率级描述源的总发声能力，声压级还依赖距离与房间，二者通过房间常数关联: Not the same: sound power level describes the source's total sound-generating capability, while sound pressure level also depends on distance and the room — the two are linked through the room constant.
